comparison.objective: Place three consumer devices on matching charging locations and verify charging; candidate commissions an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object placement, wireless-pad alignment, and flexible watch-band handling versus precision adjustment and fastener manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: All devices continuously charging after release with indicators visible and stand unmoved; candidate requires bounded mechanical impact response.
comparison.reason: Charging alignment and flexible-band handling do not overlap meaningfully with damper tuning.
